chapter: Hard times and working bands of the 1930s
title: The Budweiser dance hall band of 1935 and its members
summary: Rene lists the players in the 1935 band at the Budweiser dance hall. They were a sight-reading band that played hotel music.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh boy, it was something. It was pretty rough. Then I went to Budweiser dance hall in 35. Me and René went to that 35. Who was there at the Budweiser? Budweiser dance hall? Right there next to La Vida. You remember? Yeah, but I mean, who was with you? You had René? Me, René, Ducaugier, Ducaugier on piano, Butler rap, Gaillier they call guitar. Yeah. And Spurt on saxophone, played saxophone. Austin Young's brother? Austin Young's brother? Yeah, Austin Young's play trombone. Oh, he was there. And Eddie Handy played bass. That was his name, Eddie Handy?
Sylvester Handy. Eddie Handy's brother, the one who played bass. Well, John Handy played saxophone and clarinet. Yes, he played clarinet and saxophone.

Yeah, that's John. Yeah. And then there's one who plays guitar whose name I can't think of, Julius. Well, no, no, no. And Sylvester plays bass, but they may call him Eddie, I don't know, his real name is Sylvester.
Sylvester. Yeah, that's what he liked to hear.
And I didn't get this straight. What relation was Austin Young to Spurt? I didn't get it. Spurt was his cousin or brother or something?

Oh, yeah, it's Lester who's the cousin I think. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Lester and the kid drummer, his name begins with an L, Leon. Leon, yeah. Lee and Lester, they're two brothers. Uh-huh. And they're cousins to the other two.
I was a fine musician, boy, and he was a perfect drunkard, amateur drunkard. Who's that? Spurt.

Boyd Reed, anything, he was a sight. The band used to come, man we had such a good sight reading band till the band used to come from the hotel there. Used to come from the Roseville Hotel and different hotels and come there and bring music. And fast they'd give it to us, they'd throw it up there, we used to play. We were sight readers, you know. What does Fulet play?
What different instruments? Saxophone and clannin. Both, huh?
Yeah, he plays. Did he play alto, tenor, baritone?
Alto. He'd read any kind of music, he was wonderful, good musician.
